To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the MDA approach is not suitable for the development of complex systems in general, but that it is a useful approach for the development of systems with a high degree of complexity in their data model.
the MDA is not suitable for the modeling of business processes and that it does not support the modeling of business rules.

1) the MDA approach can be used for the modeling of business processes, 2) the MDA framework is suitable for the modeling of processes in a graphical way, 3) a graphical modeling technique can be used for modeling of processes and 4) the MDA is a good approach for the modeling of the processes in a graphical modeling technique.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework that allows the user to create a model of a system in a graphical manner, and then to use that model to automatically generate code.
the question of how to design a graphical modeling tool that supports model-driven architecture.
the development of a process oriented approach to model development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is not a single best modeling technique, but a number of modeling techniques, which are all suitable for different purposes.
there is no conclusive statement.
there is no single best modeling language.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach to model driven development.
it has been shown that a graphical model is a suitable way to describe a process, and that the use of a graphical model can support process oriented development.
we are able to show how to use the MDA framework in the context of the UML.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of graphical modeling techniques in MDA is not a panacea, but a useful tool in the toolbox of MDA.
the MDA approach can be used for modeling the process of software development, and that the process can be modeled at different abstraction levels.
the use of graphical modeling techniques in model driven development can improve the communication among developers.
